svg.title: Lina Chen
svg.desc: Synthesised from research patterns; does not represent a single participant.

g.text: Independent and digitally confident, Lina searches university
websites, social media and friends for answers. Her challenge is
judging which advice fits her situation.
• Unclear next steps and variable peer
Checks official sources, compares social advice, saves useful links and asks friends
Relevant communities / Verified identities / Low-pressure discussion / Clear booking expectations
